itinerary.title: Turkish Night Show with Dinner
itinerary.text:
DINNER, TURKISH NIGHT SHOW, ANATOLIAN FOLK DANCE, BELLY DANCER, LIVE MUSIC,
Pick up from the hotel or cruise ship port.
Take a short night drive to the restaurant, where you will enjoy an evening with a delicious full course meal of fine Turkish cuisine featuring class acts of music and dance in traditional surroundings. Enjoy the Turkish Belly Dancers and Turkish Traditional Folkshows while you are having your full course dinner. Drop off to hotel or cruise ship port.
FIX DINNER MENU:
COLD STARTERS - Seasonal stuffed vine leaves, Haydari (yoghurt, garlic and mint), Acili Ezme (tomato dip with pepper and onions), Tabule (wheat, tomato, garlic, parsley, fresh onion and mint, lemon, olive oil), Humus, Turkish white cheese, Pilaki (white beans in olive oil), tomato and cucumber
HOT APPETIZER - Cheese Pastry or Special of the day
SALAD - Mediterranean Salad
MAIN COURSE - Grilled Chicken Breast with mashed potato, grilled vegetables and rice
DESSERT - Turkish Pudding with top of fruits
DRINKS - 35 cl Wine or 1 glass of Local Alcohol or 2 Soft Drinks
Drop off to hotel at end of dinner.

faqs.q: What is included in the Bosphorus Dinner Cruise?
faqs.a: The Bosphorus Dinner Cruise includes an evening cruise along the Bosphorus Strait, dinner onboard, live entertainment performances, and stunning nighttime views of Istanbul. Guests can enjoy illuminated landmarks, traditional Turkish shows, music, and a memorable dining experience between Europe and Asia.

faqs.q: How much does the Bosphorus Dinner Cruise cost?
faqs.a: The Bosphorus Dinner Cruise starts from €75 per person for the 2026 season. Prices may vary depending on menu selection, seating category, special events, and seasonal demand. Advance reservations are recommended.

faqs.q: How long does the Bosphorus Dinner Cruise last?
faqs.a: The cruise lasts approximately 2 to 3 hours, providing plenty of time to enjoy dinner, entertainment, and panoramic views of Istanbul's waterfront attractions illuminated at night.

faqs.q: What landmarks can I see during the cruise?
faqs.a: During the cruise, you can enjoy views of iconic landmarks such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Dolmabahçe Palace, Bosphorus Bridge, Maiden's Tower, Ortaköy Mosque, waterfront mansions, and historic fortresses lining the Bosphorus.

faqs.q: Is dinner included in the cruise package?
faqs.a: Yes, dinner is included in the standard package. Guests are served a multi-course meal featuring Turkish and international cuisine. Menu options may vary depending on the cruise operator and package selected.

faqs.q: What entertainment is offered during the cruise?
faqs.a: The evening typically includes traditional Turkish folk dances, belly dancing performances, live music, cultural shows, and DJ entertainment. The performances showcase Turkey's rich cultural heritage and create a lively atmosphere onboard.

faqs.q: Is hotel pickup and drop-off included?
faqs.a: Hotel pickup and drop-off may be included depending on the selected package and hotel location. Private transfer upgrades are often available for added convenience. Please check the specific package details when booking.

faqs.q: Is the Bosphorus Dinner Cruise suitable for families and couples?
faqs.a: Yes, the cruise is suitable for couples, families, groups of friends, and solo travelers. It is especially popular with couples seeking a romantic evening and visitors looking for a unique way to experience Istanbul after dark.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Bosphorus Dinner Cruise?
faqs.a: You can usually cancel free of charge up to 24 to 48 hours before the cruise, depending on the operator's policy. Cancellations made closer to departure may incur charges. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility.

faqs.q: When is the best time to take a Bosphorus Dinner Cruise?
faqs.a: The cruise operates throughout the year and offers a unique experience in every season. Summer evenings provide warm weather and outdoor viewing opportunities, while spring, autumn, and winter cruises offer beautiful illuminated city views and a cozy onboard atmosphere.
